ns2:section.sectionText: Title: Child and Youth Development in Global Context. Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.citl.illinois.edu. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers, waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC, or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to EDM:Educatnl Psychology -UIUC, EDM:Human Resource Ed - UIUC, NDEG: HRE Online -UIUC, or EDM: Ed Policy St - UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $394.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $359.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
